trigger: The extended source-plane scan improved monotonically to p=2.6 and nearly zero scatter, with no interior optimum.
question: Is the apparent fractional-propagator gain a physical family-mapping improvement or a near-critical mass-sheet/source-collapse degeneracy?

diagnostics.global_mass_sheet_R2: Fit theta=A*alpha+b over all image positions and report explained positional variance.
diagnostics.family_mean_source_dispersion: RMS separation of inferred family-mean beta values from their global mean after the primary amplitude fit.
diagnostics.source_radius_collapse: RMS norm of all inferred beta positions divided by the no-lens theta RMS after removing a global mean.
diagnostics.interpretation: A physical lens may reduce within-family scatter, but forcing unrelated family means toward the same beta and making alpha nearly affine in theta signals the source-plane/mass-sheet degeneracy.

claim_limits: This audit diagnoses the current statistic; it does not by itself reject every possible non-Poisson propagator.
A mass-sheet-resistant image-plane calculation is required before selecting another exponent.
